command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
T0=$(date +%s)
bwa mem -t 16 -R '@RG\tID:SRR062634\tSM:HG00096\tPL:ILLUMINA' GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa SRR062634_1.filt.fastq.gz SRR062634_2.filt.fastq.gz 2> run.log | gzip -1 > aln.sam.gz
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
ALTN=$(awk 'tolower($0) ~ /read [0-9]+ alt contigs/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if(tolower($i)=="read"){print $(i+1); exit}}' run.log)
NREC=$(zcat aln.sam.gz | awk '!/^@/{n++} END{print n+0}')
GZOK=0; zcat aln.sam.gz > /dev/null 2>&1 && GZOK=1
BYTES=$(stat -c%s aln.sam.gz)
{ echo "tool              bwa"
  echo "wall_s            $WALL  (the aligner only)"
  echo "threads           16"
  echo "alt_contigs_read  $ALTN  want >0 (the analysis set must be used ALT-aware)"
  echo "sam_records       $NREC  want exactly 48817006"
  echo "gzip_ok           $GZOK  want 1"
  echo "aln_sam_gz_bytes  $BYTES"
  echo "reads_per_s       $(( 48297986 / WALL ))"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$GZOK" -eq 1
test "$ALTN" -gt 0
# bwa-mem2 documents output identical to bwa mem, so this is an exact cross-implementation
# identity on identical bytes, not a band. A mismatch is a finding, so print the delta first.
if [ "$NREC" != "48817006" ]; then echo "DELTA vs bwa: $(( NREC - 48817006 )) records"; fi
test "$NREC" = '48817006'
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
